title.en: MALACAÑAN PALACE BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES INTERNATIONAL CORPORATION AS A SUBSIDIARY OF THE BASES CONVERSION AND DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY, AND MAINTAINING THE POLICY SUPERVISION AND OPERATIONAL CONTROL OF THE DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION OVER THE CLARK INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT

text.en:
Declaration of Policy. There is a need to facilitate the full
development of the Clark International Airport (the Airport) as a major and alternative
gateway to and from the Philippines to achieve economic efficiency and support the
development thrust of the government.

Restructuring of CIAC. The CIAC is hereby restructured from
being an attached agency of DOT to a subsidiary of BCDA. The ownership of CIAC
shall be transferred to BCDA.
The DOT is hereby ordered to facilitate the transfer and convevance of the
shares currently owned by the Republic of the Philippines, as well as those shares
held in the name of its nominee stockholders, in favor of BCD and its nominees;
Provided, however, that any delay in the execution of such documents of transfer
and conveyance of the shares of stock of CIAC shall not, in any event, delay, hinder
or deter the immediate exercise of ownership rights over CIAC by BCDA.
The respective governing boards and management of ClAC and BCDA are
directed to implement all pertinent laws, rules and regulations necessary for the said

transfer of shares, and to take all proper and necessary steps under Securities and
Exchange Commission regulations to accomplish this purpose.
All other heads of government departments, bureaus, offices, agencies,
government-owned and -controlled corporations and instrumentalities are hereby
enjoined to render full assistance and cooperation to CIAC for the full development

Mandate of CIAC. The CIAC shall only engage in civil aviation,
aviation-related services and aviation-related logistics activities within CCAC and the
Clark Industrial Estate 5 areas, as defined in EO No. 716. For all other business
activities, prior approval of the DOT and BCDA shall be secured.

Authority of DOT. The DOT shall exercise policy supervision
and full regulatory and operational control over the operations of the Airport.

Board of Directors. The powers and functions of the CIAC shall
be vested in and exercised by a Board of Directors to be composed of the following:
Chairperson:
Secretary of Transportation
or designated representative (ex officio)
Vice-Chairpersons:
Secretary of Tourism
or designated representative (ex officio)
President of the BCDA
or designated representative (ex officio)
President and Chief Executive Officer of the CIAC
or designated representative (ex officio)
The Director General of the Civil Aviation Authority
of the Philippines (CAAP) or designated
representative (ex officio), and six (6) other
members to be appointed by the President of the
Philippines, upon consultation with the Secretary
of Transportation and President of the BCDA;
Provided, however, that the nomination and
appointment of the six (6) appointive directors shall
comply with the provisions of RA 10149, otherwise
known as the "GOCC Governance Act of 2011."

Authority of CDC. CDC shall continue to exercise its authority
as the implementing arm of the BCD within the CFZ and CSEZ, pursuant to Section
15 of RA No. 7227, as amended by RA No. 9400.

Recognition of Existing Contracts. All contracts, leases and
business arrangements previously entered into by CDC within the CCAC shall be
honored, subject to applicable laws and issuances, including the terms and

conditions that may be stipulated in the implementing rules and regulations of this

Implementing Rules and Regulations. The BCDA, CDC and
CIAC, in consultation with DOT, are hereby directed to adopt implementing rules
and regulations within thirty (30 days from the effectivity of this Order.

Repeal. All orders, proclamations, rules, regulations, or parts
thereof, which are inconsistent with any of the provisions of this Order are hereby
repealed or modified accordingly.

Separability. If any provision of this Order be declared invalid
or unconstitutional, the other provisions unaffected shall remain valid and subsisting.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately upon
publication in a newspaper of general circulation.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 28th day of February
the year of our Lord Two Thousand and Seventeen.
By the President:
SALVADOR C. MEDIALDEA
Executive Secretary
